description: Usturlap - We are an fully established team that knows each other well with clearly defined roles, coming together for the NASA Space Apps Challenge Ankara. Our project will focus on developing innovative solutions by analyzing open-source data from NASA and partner space agencies. At this moment, our team is at full capacity and we are not looking for new members. We wish the best of luck to all competing teams!
summary: At first, we have decided to take "Space Mission Game Challange". We have observed that real Mars landings and scientific data collection operations rely on highly complex, technical datasets that are hard for the general public to interpret. Because raw scientific data offen feels inaccesible, many people miss out on understanding how actual space operations like in our project Mars landing and data collecting operataions work. To solve this under the Space Mission Challange we build an interactive Mars landing and data collection game using NASA’s resources. Our platform translates real mission and environmental data into playable physics and decision mechanics. Players manage descent and surface operations with real-time feedback, turning complex scientific data into a fun, intuitive, and educational experience for everyone.
details:
Game Overview

Title: Mars Ops: Ares-7

Platform: Browser (available on both desktop and mobile)

Genre / Perspective: 3D first-person Mars science expedition game

Setting & Mission Flow

Environment: A rust-red Martian crater landscape featuring a modular habitat base.

Entry & Setup: Begins with a brief atmospheric landing sequence and a streamlined mission setup leading directly into sequential surface objectives.

Core Gameplay Loop:

1. Explore the Martian surface starting from a modular habitat.

2. Complete three timed science scans across distinct stations.

3. Return to the base to resolve a crisis and transmit your findings.
